purpose: Observe only the already returned PID start identity, executable symlink value and bounded cgroup public fields. No service, unit, container or executable version is inferred from a name.

requested_identity_reads.projection: PID and start_ticks only; command-name bytes not exported
four Uid integers only; other status content not exported
at most16 hierarchy/controllers/path records, path<=2048 bytes
absolute symlink target text <=4096 UTF8 bytes; target file not opened or hashed

fixed_order: independent before boot/stat/Uid and directory identity
one exe readlink only if preceding projection succeeded
independent after boot/stat/Uid and directory identity

refusal_behavior.projection_errno_or_shape_failure: Record original static stage/error code/errno; stop all remaining projection reads. No retry, sudo, alternative path or other PID.
refusal_behavior.after_on_projection_failure: The planned independent after-identity read still runs if the soft deadline permits. It closes the same fixed observation; it is not an alternate projection or privilege fallback.
refusal_behavior.partial_result: A successfully read cgroup may be released if later exe readlink is denied, but only after matching independent before/after identity and no explicit close error. Overall ok remains false and all_requested_public_fields_observed remains false.
refusal_behavior.identity_drift_or_after_failure: Discard the entire public projection; preserve before/after identity facts, static error and explicit close-error facts.
refusal_behavior.output_cap: Replace oversize public JSON with a small static failure; no truncated success output.
refusal_behavior.unknown: Missing ACK or transport UNKNOWN stops new admissions. This SOURCE authorizes no automatic process_start retry, cancellation or replay.

resource_bounds.scheduling_caveat: The soft clock is checked around each fixed syscall; it cannot interrupt a blocked syscall. Native timeout/terminal/stream closure must be observed independently after any future approved execution.

close_scope: Each acquired local descriptor has a finally once-close path. Explicit close failures veto release; no broad resource-closure claim is inferred merely from an empty error list. A future run still needs the authoritative original job terminal and full streams.
atomicity: Before/after equality is two sampled observations of one fixed PID/start tuple. It is not an atomic process snapshot, a guarantee against every transient credential change, or proof of binary content/version.

interpreter.missing_or_refused: Stop; no alternative interpreter or bootstrap.

observation_proposal_only.protocol: Existing Git-first discipline: exact request+once intent whole before an independent call boundary, entire original SDK external whole before parsing; original job only.

excluded: service status queries inferred from text
